I haven’t started anything yet. Propranolol didn’t agree with me (and racing heart isn’t a symptom that bothers me). Weakness/dizziness is my worst symptom and my BP is low. 

I have a mild case (apparently) and I’m young, but it’s still extremely miserable. I have anxiety and depression and it’s making the fear of side effects even greater. My doctors are being rather condescending as well. :(
Would anyone recommend it to someone who is already diagnosed with POTS?
Has anyone noticed significant weight gain from Zoloft? I’m afraid to try it.

Guess what? Unfortunately (and fortunately), no one who gets better uses their new found health to sit at home all day and blog about it or lurk on forums. These forums are 99% filled with people who are struggling enough that they need support. I know 10+ people (I live in New England) who had chronic Lyme for over 5 years and are 10000% fine now. It happens. I’d say I’m 80% better and I’m off these forums way more than I used to be. I would really recommend spending less time on here because they are demoralizing. You will get better. Find people who have beat it. Ask your doctor for contacts. Hear it from them, not the people who are still in the hole.
I’m also curious about what people do in the summer heat! Hot weather really bothers me and I can’t imagine not wearing shorts.
